description: Find the countries SimFuse sells eSIMs for, with the cheapest plan price ("from" price) for each in the currency you ask for. Start here when someone names a place: it turns "Portugal" into the two-letter country code the other tools take, and shows what that destination starts at. For one destination, follow it with list-plans; for a trip covering two or more countries, use plan-trip instead. Read-only, and it answers from the SimFuse catalog alone.

currency.description: Optional. ISO 4217 three-letter code the "from" prices are quoted in, e.g. "USD", "EUR", "GBP". Defaults to EUR. An unknown code falls back to EUR rather than failing.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum destinations to return, 1 to 300. Defaults to 300, which is the whole list.

search.description: Optional. Match destinations by name, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitively. A partial name works: "port" matches Portugal. Omit to list every destination.

name: list-destinations

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every from_price_cents below is quoted in, e.g. "EUR".

destinations.description: The matching destinations. Empty when nothing matched.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the from_price_cents beside it is expressed in, which is the currency you asked for, e.g. "EUR". Null exactly when from_price_cents is null, which is what a country nested on a plan answers: nothing priced it there.

from_price_cents.description: Cheapest plan for this destination, in minor units (cents) of the response currency, so 1250 is 12.50. Null when this response did not price the destination.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "ES". This is the code list-plans and plan-trip take.

path.description: Path on the storefront, e.g. "/esim/spain/". Always the canonical page, never a redirect.

query.description: Query parameters that belong on the path, as an object. Empty when there are none.

url.description: The full storefront URL for this country's storefront page. Safe to show to a person.

region.description: The region this country is filed under, e.g. "Europe". Null when it is filed under none.

returned.description: How many destinations are in this response.

total.description: How many destinations matched, before `limit` was applied.

title: List eSIM destinations
